tokenHelp: Create an access token in the VRM portal under Preferences → Integrations → Access tokens.
sitesHelp: Leave empty to poll all installations. The list is loaded via the running instance – save the token first if the list stays empty.
intervalHelp: How fresh the data is depends on the log interval of the GX device (Settings → VRM online portal → Log interval). Polling faster than that interval brings no benefit.
staleHelp: Sets info.dataStale when VRM has received no new data from the GX device for this time.
phaseSumsHelp: Creates an additional total for power, current and energy values reported per phase (L1, L2, L3) in the "sum" folder of the device.
energyStatsHelp: PV yield, consumption, grid import/export and battery charged/discharged for today, week, month and year (one request per installation).
forecastHelp: PV yield and consumption for today (total and rest of the day) and tomorrow, plus the hourly forecast as JSON. The rest of today is updated every 5 minutes without a new request.
alarmsHelp: Number and list of the active alarms, the newest alarm and the last 25 entries of the VRM alarm log as JSON.
cleanupHelp: At every start, deletes the objects of installations that are no longer polled, of devices that VRM no longer reports, of disabled options and the phase sums when they are disabled. History data of deleted states is kept, but their settings (e.g. history) are lost.
excludeHelp: One pattern per line, * and ? as wildcards, # for comments. A pattern matches a device (gateway_0, MultiPlus*), a value (ve_bus_system_276.vvp) or the name of a value (*alarm*). Applies to diagnostics, phase sums and the device list, live values are always kept. Enable "Delete obsolete objects" to remove existing objects.
